items.q: Do I need to move the furniture?
items.a: Absolutely not! We come with everything needed and clean on-site. We only ask you to clear a little space around the furniture.

items.q: How long does it take to dry?
items.a: With injection-extraction, fabric dries in 2–4 hours — much faster than traditional wet cleaning. You can use your furniture the same day.

items.q: Is it safe for children and pets?
items.a: Yes. We only use certified, biodegradable products. Once dry, they leave no harmful residues.

items.q: Can you remove old stains?
items.a: In most cases — yes. Injection-extraction is very effective even on stubborn stains. With prior information about the stain type, we can assess the chance of full removal.

items.q: How much does it cost and how do I pay?
items.a: Prices depend on type and size. All prices are transparent — no hidden fees. Payment is in cash or bank transfer after the service.

items.q: Which areas do you cover?
items.a: We cover Bansko, Razlog, Dobrinishte, Banya and the entire Bansko-Razlog valley. For more distant locations — contact us.

items.q: How much does sofa cleaning cost in Bansko?
items.a: Sofa cleaning in Bansko starts from €25 for a 2-seater and up to €45 for a large corner sofa. Mattresses from €20, carpets from €4/m², curtains from €15. All prices are listed on our Pricing page with no hidden fees. Payment is made after the service — cash or bank transfer — only if you are satisfied.

items.q: Can you remove pet odours and smells?
items.a: Yes. The injection-extraction method extracts contaminants from deep within the fabric, including odours from dogs, cats and cigarette smoke. For stronger odours, we apply enzyme-based treatments at no extra charge. Most clients report complete odour elimination after a single treatment.

items.q: Do you clean for hotels and Airbnb rentals in Bansko?
items.a: Yes, we serve hotels, villas and rental apartments in Bansko and the surrounding area. We offer priority scheduling between tenant stays, volume pricing for larger properties, and seasonal cleaning contracts at the end of ski season. Contact us for a corporate quote.

items.q: Do you cover Dobrinishte, Banya and Razlog?
items.a: Yes, we cover Dobrinishte, Banya, Razlog and all villages in the Bansko-Razlog valley with no extra travel charge. For locations outside this area, please contact us in advance to confirm availability.

items.q: Do you work during ski season and on weekends?
items.a: Yes, we work every day from 08:00 to 20:00, including weekends and public holidays. Ski season (December–March) is our busiest period — we recommend booking at least 1–2 days in advance to secure your preferred time slot.

items.q: How often should sofas and mattresses be cleaned?
items.a: We recommend cleaning sofas at least once a year with normal use, or every 6 months if you have pets or young children. Mattresses should ideally be cleaned every 6–12 months — dust mites thrive in uncleaned mattresses and are a common cause of allergies and poor sleep.

items.q: How quickly can you clean after check-out?
items.a: Typically we start within 1–2 hours after check-out. Regular contract clients are prioritised.

items.q: Do you handle properties with many units?
items.a: Yes. We have capacity for hotels with 20+ rooms. We assess volume during the on-site visit and propose a schedule.

items.q: Do we sign a contract?
items.a: For monthly contracts — yes. For one-off cleaning we work without a formal contract, just a written quote.

items.q: Do you issue invoices?
items.a: Yes, we issue a company invoice for every service.

items.q: How do you access the property?
items.a: We coordinate with you or your front desk in advance. The owner does not need to be present during the cleaning.

items.q: Do you work during the ski season?
items.a: Yes, we work year-round including peak ski season. We recommend booking in advance for the December–March period.

items.q: Can you clean on the check-out / check-in day?
items.a: Yes — that's exactly what we're here for. We schedule around your guest turnover, including tight windows between checkout and check-in.

items.q: Are the cleaning products safe for the next guests?
items.a: Yes. We use certified low-foam products with no strong odours. Furniture is fully ready to use after 2–4 hours of drying.
